The Musko Nigerian Land Covenant

Eliminating Fear in Nigerian Real Estate

We understand the fears Nigerian buyers face: fake survey plans, land-grabbers, unapproved layouts, and family funds lost to deceit. Here is how our corporate verification safeguards every kobo you invest.

01
Legal Due Diligence

AGIS & FCDA Cadastral Title Perfection

Every layout is legally charted against the Abuja Masterplan at the Abuja Geographic Information Systems (AGIS) and Gwagwalada Area Council. We only sell lands with verified Right of Occupancy (R of O), Certificate of Occupancy (C of O), or Area Council regularized gazettes.

Zero risk of demolition, green-belt overlap, or government road reservation acquisitions.
02
100% Customary Clearance

Zero Omo-Onile & Native Community Clashes

In Nigeria, customary land claims often lead to harassment and stalled construction. At Musko, full financial and traditional compensation is executed, sealed by legal affidavits and community youth leader agreements before any plot is offered for sale.

No youth interference, no illegal tolls, no double selling of ancestral lands.
03
Tangible Possession

Instant Physical Concrete Beacon Planting

We do not allocate on paper alone. When you reach your allocation milestone, concrete boundary beacons stamped with SURCON registered geodetic coordinates are physically cast and planted in the ground in your presence.

Satellite coordinates tied into the Office of the Surveyor General of the Federation (OSGOF).
04
Institutional Security

Corporate Bank Accounts & EFCC SCUML Compliance

Musko Properties is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (RC-1849204) and fully certified by the EFCC Special Control Unit Against Money Laundering (SCUML). All funds must be deposited into verified corporate bank accounts—never private individuals.

Official receipting, milestone invoicing, and enforceable corporate contract covenants.
05
UK, US, Canada & UAE Desk

Diaspora Anti-Fraud Concierge & International Courier

Over 65% of our clients reside abroad. We eliminate the painful risk of sending funds through untrustworthy relatives. You attend 4K live drone walkthroughs via WhatsApp video call and receive your original stamped deeds at your overseas doorstep via DHL/FedEx.

Complete remote transparency with direct CEO and executive office accessibility.
06
Transparent Pricing

Zero Hidden Fees & No Extortion Guarantee

What you see is what you pay. Musko Properties operates an unshakeable zero-hidden-fee policy. No surprise "bush entry fees", no unannounced developmental levies, and no surveyor ransom charges after buying.

All inclusive pricing with flexible 6 to 12-month payment options in Nigerian Naira (₦).
